newsitem.title: UK: Active Imaging says may get bid offer.
newsitem.headline: Active Imaging says may get bid offer.

text.p: Britain's Active Imaging Plc said on Tuesday it was in talks with an undisclosed third party that may lead to an offer being made for the computer imaging firm.
Active Imaging also said it would not meet market expectations for its trading results for the year due to a shortfall in revenues.
The company's shares were marked up 4.5p to 80 at 1030 GMT.
Active Imaging said a downturn at Data Cell Ltd in the second and third quarters and subsequent delays in the closure of firm orders for its InVision camera would hit year results.
However, the company said revenues for Data Cell in the last quarter should return to previous levels.
The company said it would make a further announcement about the progress of its talks in due course.
